brief:
Gaza's health ministry issued an epidemiological alert across the territory, warning of a sharp rise in meningitis infections that threatens hundreds of thousands of residents, Middle East Eye reported. The ministry attributed the outbreak to Israeli restrictions, which have hampered disease surveillance and treatment capacity throughout the enclave.

The alert comes as health conditions deteriorate in Gaza amid ongoing conflict and blockade measures that have constrained medical resources and public health infrastructure.
